notes.title: Update v.1.2.2
notes.notes:
The Deer now uses an idle animation (on one's feet.) when it is in freeze mode, making it easier to spot him.

Reduced the Deer’s damage from 55 to 40 so players with less than full HP can react after being hit.

For the first 3 days on free maps, the weather will always be Good, making it easier for newcomers to meet the first quota and get familiar with the game.

Fixed a bug with trees on Old Castle

You now get 6 cooked eggs or 3 packs of nuggets from a bird egg.

notes.title: Update v.1.2.1
notes.notes:
Fixed AI navigation issues

Corrected some translation errors

Improved collision on the white cabinet

Fixed wrong shadows on the terrain

notes.title: Update v.1.2.0
notes.notes:
You can now restart the game immediately without needing to recreate the lobby. (Host Button Only)

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45490594/f919cfa946f334722e5f73f9ca7483ff5c2811cf.png"]

Burning barrels now provide warmth 10 times faster!

Killed or angry aliens will now displayed as "ERROR" on the Radar Map.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45490594/e67caba2aeab53aedbd72bd16dd92056963096b9.png"]

Killed aliens now drop money (half of the normal payout).

Please don’t try to kill them after delivery — it doesn’t make any sense.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45490594/d7a0caba403f5724f0dfdcf38bedc44fbcf4519d.png"]

Calories are now tracked not only in the food alien menu, but also for you and the fridge.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45490594/ab5fa653e903702ffd95c79b6cd8dfa9304e1738.png"]

The quota multiplier has been reworked — it no longer increases abruptly. Instead, the growth percentage gradually decreases over time. Now there are no impossible quotas, and everything should feel fair. Stock up on food and aim for a new record!  

The quota multiplier will decrease down to 1.2 and then stay fixed at that value. Here’s how it looks: 2.1 1.95 1.8 1.7 1.6 1.5 1.4 1.3 1.2....



Since the game doesn't have version checking, it's recommended to avoid joining public lobbies — at least for the first few hours :) — until everyone has updated.

notes.title: Update v.1.1.6
notes.notes:
Reworked water rising behavior for the "Flood" and "Hell" weather situation. The water now rises slightly slower and can no longer rise above your bunker doors, giving you a fair chance to run in and out without being completely submerged.

Fixed a bug where the quick right-hand interaction animation would not play.

Removed the "No Signal" overlay from dead players' cameras, as it often behaved incorrectly and could flicker.

Various minor game and balance adjustments.

notes.title: Update v.1.1.5
notes.notes:
Major steps toward optimization

Reworked overall sound volume and balanced walkie-talkie volume

Medkits now restore more health

notes.title: Update v.1.1.0
notes.notes:
Increased damage of the knife and shovel

Increased the angle you need to look at for the Deer to freeze

After Swampy deals damage, he will return to Mode 1, giving you a chance to break the sprint

Train ride reworked to reduce lag during world generation

Improved NetCode in some areas to reduce CPU usage

Server region window has been moved to the center

Dropped items no longer fly away as far

Fixed a bug where the tunnel SEED didn't match during generation

Other minor tweaks and fixes

! P.S Since the game doesn't have version checking, it's recommended to avoid joining public lobbies — at least for the first few hours :) — until everyone has updated. !

notes.title: Release Date & Time
notes.notes:
Hey Couriers! 

I've got some big news to share with you! On Tuesday, July 29th, delivery pals will be fully released at 10am CST | 8am PST | 5pm CEST | 11am EST and there will be a 10% launch discount. 




[previewyoutube="MG2zxJw4Cek;full"][/previewyoutube]


Here's what you can expect: 

Exploring different maps and scavenging for goods

Play with up to six friends

Character customizations with different hats and glasses 

Cooking food inside your train base

Delivering orders to aliens and earning money

Buying items from the shop with the money you earn or putting your earnings into the ATM for the overall quota during the round



Each round will have a different quota amount for you and your friends to fulfill, and customers will vary on the amount of calories you will need to bring them. I hope you will all enjoy the game!



As we get closer to the launch, it would mean a lot if you could drop me a wishlist as it will help a lot with visibility. 



[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3237570/delivery_pals/"][/dynamiclink]

Thank you so much for your support, and I will see you all on Tuesday in the game!



Best Regards,

stre1itzia
